text:
Scott Sabourin is 34, undrafted, on his fourth NHL team, and the Lightning's enforcer. He fought Mathieu Olivier in Columbus on Nov 12, a bout that got headlines from Markerzone to the Times of India, and the Tampa Bay Times wrote about the sparring sessions behind it. The team also put out a video on his Muay Thai training.

The hockey: eight games, about nine minutes a night, one goal and one assist. The goal came in the 8-3 win in Buffalo on Nov 11, on one of only three shots he's taken. Our numbers won't pretend a 33% shooting percentage means anything.

At five on five Tampa is about even in chances with him on, though worse than without him. Tampa has won six of the eight games he's played, and that's partly the point of having him: he plays fourth-line minutes and lets everyone else play their game.

What to watch: his spot in the lineup as Tampa's injured forwards return. Players like him come and go with the matchup.
